value.rationale: The complete arithmetic boundary of the natural noncrystallographic H3 reflection arrangement is mathematically motivated by its well-studied 31-point geometry. The results give a full prime classification, a scheme-theoretic nonreduced special-fiber equation, and a complete labeled degeneration census with nontrivial partition by old multiplicity class. They connect Calvo’s characteristic-zero 31-point geometry to a reduced eight-point interpolation configuration. This is more than a small numeric sample or routine consequence of an already tabulated arrangement; the abstract 7/3 invariant is carefully credited as already known.
